protectedInvariants: no customer-territory mutation without an exact customer capability
no unrecorded or falsely zero resource use
no supplier result treated as customer acceptance
no repeated cycle without new delivery refusal or receipt evidence
no SDSS self-customer used as evidence of customer value
no local MAPE artifact claimed as standing-campaign completion
no bounded campaign cycle without a causally reopened Monitor
no customer usefulness acceptance treated as receiver admission or installation
no provider bid over a drifted or unreplayable customer lot
no descriptive product promise substituted for an exact machine-readable codomain
no award-readiness offer without exact lot, bid snapshot, review target, and independent boundary examination

rules.when: no purpose-owning external customer has received an SDSS response
a resource receipt contains unknown measurements
a customer accepted a useful result and its observed resources are measured
a customer accepts useful proposal bytes without receiver installation authority
a tender correction recurs because the output codomain or customer lot identity remains ambiguous
a content-addressed superseding lot produces an exact bid and procured semantic review
any bounded standing-campaign transition is recorded

executionLaw: Operatively enforced only by the mandatory executionGuard hook below; this policy text grants no mutation authority.

executionGuard.fires: immediately before every SDSS RSI Execute domain mutation
requiresExact: current appointment or accepted-contract authority source
executionGuard.refusal: Append a typed non-execution and perform no domain, customer-territory, or foreign-territory mutation.

knowledgeLaw: Every provider-local change record names its predecessor, evidence digest, gaps, selected action, actual execution disposition, protected invariants, and next observation basis. The standing campaign additionally names its fresh cross-session/corpus frame, purpose-owning customer, external demand, provider market, receiver outcome or open gap, and effect on capability, autonomy, sovereignty, and cost power. Every bounded standing-campaign transition MUST end in a causal successor Monitor with campaignTerminal false and nextAnalysisRequired true.
